key_catalyst: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire and Strait of Hormuz reopening spark massive risk-on rotation into equities.
reasoning: Today's dominant catalyst is the sudden de-escalation of Middle East tensions—an Israel-Lebanon ceasefire and Strait of Hormuz reopening—removing a major headwind that weighed on QQQ throughout recent sessions. While Alphabet's upcoming earnings introduce uncertainty, the novel geopolitical resolution is overwhelmingly positive and represents a receding threat; there is no high-conviction reason to exit ahead of the open.
